title: The CLI day to day: images, containers, volumes and networks

videos.script: After a week, a machine running Docker is full of things nobody remembers starting. This lesson is the everyday command line. {{find}} First, finding things: filters, formats, and one field at a time from docker inspect. And why a count of log lines came out as zero. {{inside}} Then a container with no shell. Docker top, diff and cp work from outside, and a second container can borrow the first one's network or processes. {{clean}} And last, cleaning up. Docker deletes nothing on its own. Each prune command frees something different, and one of them deletes data.
